stem: If $f: R \to R$ then mention the degree of the function: $f(x)=x^{{=m}}(x-{=a})^2-x^{{=m+2}}$
solution: The highest power of x is {=m+1}.
The last step states the answer: degree {=m+1}.
notes: Leading terms cancel after expansion, so the degree is one less than the naive m+2. Same method as book 2-b and 2-d (expand, then read the highest power).
